name: Po
source:
Po is a deeply emotional creature with a "delicate constitution" (as in, it tends to faint a lot). It only reacts to situations in extreme ways, whether or not such a strong response is really needed. Being the spawn of its tribe's current chief and a very attractive individual, Po has a never ending amount of suitors. This overabundance of attention has turned Po off from the concept of relationships. It'd take something pretty special to impress it.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43343]Lemma Soft Forum thread[/url]]
